notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Ivy Lane Denizen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Saproling you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and creature tokens, you may put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control using Ghave's second ability.
